title: i'd like to use iphone a bit.

messages.text: i'd like to use iphone a bit.

Yes. The clean moment is about 08:32Z, when part 2 of the heat test ends; a console step will tell you the phone is yours.
- Part 3 then waits until you press Done on that step; take as long as you need.
- If you need it right now, go ahead: the hold that is running (H7) gets thrown out and run again; no result is lost.
- After you hand it back, the test warms the phone up again (a few minutes), then runs part 3 (about 30 min).
- Keep it plugged in if you can; if you unplug it, plug it back in before pressing Done.

What you need to do: wait for the console step at about 08:32Z, or use the phone now if it can't wait.
Now, can you interrupt a bit ?

Yes: the test is stopping now, and the phone is yours within about a minute.
- fix-g0-box stops the running hold; it gets thrown out and run again later, so no counted result is lost.
- A console step will say the phone is yours; press Done on it when you hand it back.
- You can start using it already if you like; the automated swipes may move the screen for a few seconds until the stop lands.

What you need to do: use the iPhone, then press Done on the console step.

Thanks; the phone is back with the heat test (Done at 08:25Z).
- Next: re-warm the phone, rerun hold H8, then part 3 (about 35-40 min).

What you need to do: leave the iPhone alone and plugged in.
